name: HUMPIRE GLITCH
tagline: Bitcrusher from 1 to 16 bits with sample-rate reduction, speaker filter and dither.
sub: Bitcrusher, rate reducer and speaker filter
gumroad_title: HUMPIRE GLITCH - Lo-Fi Bitcrusher VST3 + AU Plugin (20 Presets) | Bitcrusher, Sample Rate, Speaker
summary: A lo-fi plugin with a 1 to 16 bit crusher, sample-rate reducer, mono speaker filter and dither.
about: HUMPIRE GLITCH is a lo-fi effect on a handheld-console body. The signal goes through a drive stage, a sample-rate reducer (500 Hz to 48 kHz), a dither stage and a bit quantizer from 1 to 16 bits with fractional values allowed.

The speaker switch sums to mono and passes the signal through a high-pass and low-pass filter with soft saturation. The Size knob changes the speaker from small to large. Dither can be Off, RPDF or TPDF.
The plugin adds no latency and ships with 20 presets.

features.d: 500 Hz to 48 kHz, with intentional aliasing.
Mono small-speaker simulation with a size control.
Dry/wet mix and -24 to +12 dB output.
Factory presets grouped by category, user presets saved by name, A/B compare, undo and redo.
Scales from 50% to 200% with the proportions locked. Simple and Clean display modes.

includes: HUMPIRE GLITCH plugin (Windows VST3; macOS VST3 + Audio Unit)

faq.q: Which DAWs does it work in?
faq.a: It is a VST3 effect on Windows and macOS, plus Audio Unit on macOS. It is designed for FL Studio and should load in any host that supports these formats.

faq.q: How many presets does it have?
faq.a: 20 factory presets, grouped by instrument category.

faq.q: Can I save my own presets?
faq.a: Yes. The SAVE button stores the current settings under a name you choose, and they appear in the User category of the preset menu.
